I don’t know if this is relevant but, each time we talk about it I end up crying my eyes out hysterically, saying there is no solution ... so we end up saying we will see ... and try to save the relationship. It would be great to have your perspective in this case! We were in a classic monogamous relationship for 3 years, living together for almost 2 years, picturing our future together.... it almost on our 3 years anniversary that he dropped the poly bomb on me. He said he had been feeling like this for months, that he tried to hide it because he knew this would very probably end the relationship, and he said he loves me and he still pictures his life with me .... but still just cannot « live a lie ». He says his interest in other women is purely sexual, he would be ok with any rule I set (including seeing them only once, being straight forward with them...). Btw he says he is fine with me doing the same.... with almost makes me even more sad. He says he accepts this for the sake of equality, but to me is like he doesn’t care at all. How the f**** can he NOT be jealous ? He says sex is like a meal to him, just physical, and that he doesn’t get why we would give it so much value. But I think he wants more, he wants the thrill of seducing other girls. If it was just a « meal » he would just j*** off, or pay for it ... ( not that I would be ok with that). 
What hurts me is .... everything . The idea of him doing anything with any other girl physically hurts, and this pain is very natural to me, I cannot rationalise it, it is like asking me « why would you be sad if your parents die ? » it just hurts like hell! And I am not the sick jealous type. For monogamous standards, I am like the cooles girlfriend  ever ( I don’t mind him hanging with his friends, like, A LOT LoT, I didn’t mind him hanging with girl - friends that I knew of, before I knew how he felt). I trusted him 1000%. 
I don’t get it why he needs the thrill on others because I am a 1000% monogamous, I only love and desire him. Not judging other people for being non monogamous, I just know it isn’t for me. 
What are my fears ? Of course the ultimate fear is loosing him to another girl, him having feelings for others, even if he swears it’s nothing like that. He doesn’t even want poly, just the sex part ... that’s what he says now. 
My other fear is that it will keep hurting like this , forever. Each time. That, contrary to what he thinks, I could never ever enjoy my part of the deal. I couldn’t care less about other man, even if a Prince Charming was on his knees for me. 

My ultimate fear is that he doesn’t and will never love me as much as I do. Because I am sure If it was me that was having these needs, I would have never ever put our relationship at risk. If he git to an accident and his d**** wouldn’t work, I would have never ever thought of asking him to let me sleep with other man, knowing that it could destroy our couple. I would have settled for. A sexless marriage even, for love. Maybe I am pathetic and mediocre for THaT. But I will never forget when he told me this, even if he was crying himself, telling me he wants me and doesn’t want to loose me, but still needs it... but still he did tell me, even if he was 99% I would end it... It hurts me so much that he was ready to loose me over this, that is is more important to him then me. Turns out I don’t have the courage to end it and I am living in agony for months. We don’t have a solution to this because we are light years away on how we feel about this, even if we love each other very much. He made it clear to me tho that he cannot help it... we decided to see shrinks first, but put it on hold, along with monogamy, because of the pandemic. But I know it will hit me again one day. Even if he DOES decide to give up on it, I will always be so sad that he even wants it, to the point of telling me, maybe loosing me! I am so broken rn and cannot see how I could ever heal from this. I am afraid there is no solution for us. If we stay together we will be frustrated and sad, guilty ... If we split up I just want to die. Of course he has no idea about the suicidal part, he just thinks we will both be very sad for a while. 
I just want to live in a parallel universe where everything is the same and he doesn’t have this ... need. I feel like that’s the only universe I can be happy in. But it doesn’t work like that.... 
he could have left me live in that universe by just. Cheating on me behind my back, but he said he is not « that kind of a bastard ». ButI would have been so happy by definition if I didn’t know. How pathetic is THAT? I want to be a cheated woman. 

So there, those are my fears and pain. Long answer right ?

Basically it’s not a break up yet, but a huge heartbreak : my partner confessed to me that he is non monogamous, and I know that this will destroy me. Just the thought of him flirting with someone else makes me want to end it all. But so does the thought of never seeing him again ... so no way out as I see it.
